ice_crystallite.name: Ice
ice_crystallite.concept: White-translucent angular crystallite with cold, sharp features

speech_bubbles.greeting: Feeling cold yet? Take a peek...
speech_bubbles.taunt: You can't shatter my focus. I'm permanent.
speech_bubbles.scare: I'm freezing right through your veins!

heroin_bag.name: Heroin
heroin_bag.concept: Slumped Ziploc bag containing white powder pooling at the bottom

speech_bubbles.greeting: Just rest your eyes for a second...
speech_bubbles.taunt: Too heavy to walk away, aren't you?

weed_leaf.name: Weed
weed_leaf.concept: Cannabis-shaped 5-pointed leaf walking on root-like tendrils

speech_bubbles.greeting: Hey friend, relax... what's the rush?
speech_bubbles.taunt: Just a little harmless chill, right?

ecstasy_pill.name: Ecstasy
ecstasy_pill.concept: Heart-shaped pill in bright neon orange with a center score line

speech_bubbles.greeting: Feel the beat! Let's go fast!
speech_bubbles.taunt: Your heart can't keep up with this pace!

ketamine_capsule.name: Ketamine
ketamine_capsule.concept: Silver-coloured metallic pharmaceutical pill with high reflectivity

speech_bubbles.greeting: Entering the K-hole... watch your step.
speech_bubbles.taunt: Are you floating or falling? Hard to tell.
speech_bubbles.scare: Boo!! Your mind is slipping away!
